operators.name: clone_to_cuda
semantics: Corresponds to x_clone = torch.clone(x) where x is originally on CPU and the clone is transferred to CUDA.
Preserves shape, dtype, and values; no broadcasting or axis changes.
Returns a new tensor on CUDA with contiguous or reference-compatible strides (contiguous acceptable).

operators.name: rot90_1_2
semantics: Corresponds to x_rotated = torch.rot90(x_clone, k=1, dims=(1, 2)).
Rotates the tensor 90 degrees counterclockwise in the plane specified by dims (1,2), so dimensions 1 and 2 are transposed and dimension 2 is reversed.
Output shape is [batch, dim2, dim1, dim3] = [512, 320, 3, 320].
Clone of input x; x is CPU tensor of shape [512,3,320,320] float32.
Output is on CUDA with same values and shape; stride can be contiguous.
Rotate x_clone 90 degrees counterclockwise in dims (1,2).
Output shape [512, 320, 3, 320], dtype float32, device CUDA.
The resulting tensor is contiguous in the new layout as per reference stride.
